items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was talking with Howell Land [phonetic sp.], and Howell said, "Moody?"

ctx.x: Yeah. I was talking with Howell Land [phonetic sp.], and Howell said, "Moody?" I said, "I wish I could just stay home and be with my daughter." You know, like, because Michelle was just -- she was like, a -- a baby, you know. So what I did was I -- I was talking with Howell Land and Howell was working with Tony Bennett in Vegas. He says, "Why don't you talk to Jimmy Mullidor [phonetic sp.]?" You know, he was a contractor in Vegas.
